Heard learned counsel Mr. G. Alam for the petitioner, Simanta Boro.

2. This application has been filed by the petitioner under Section 438 of the Cr.PC with prayer for pre-arrest bail as he is apprehending arrest in connection with Palashbari P.S. Case No. 177/2024 under Sections Page No.# 2/3 420/344/366 of the IPC.

3. Heard Ms. S. Jahan, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam for the respondent State.
4.
The FIR unfolds that the petitioner had a love relationship with the informant.

sentences.text: 5. On 29.11.2023, the petitioner took the informant with false promises of marriage.
Thereafter, the petitioner started to subject the informant to cruelty and after 11/2 months, the petitioner drove out the informant from his house.
6. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that no case under Sections 420/344/366 of the IPC is made out.
7. It is submitted that, the victim on her own volition went to the petitioner's house and she was staying with him.

8. As per customary rites, a community meeting was held and a date was fixed for marriage,
Annexure-2 is the minutes of the meeting with signature of the members present in the meeting,
and Annexure-3 is the marriage invitation card as a date for marriage was fixed on 01.03.2024, as per discussions held on 21.11.2023.

9. It is further submitted that no case under section 420 of the IPC has been made out against the petitioner as there is no instance of cheating and the petitioner is willing to marry the informant, but the informant is not willing to marry the petitioner and she has slammed a false case against the petitioner.
Page No.# 3/3 10.
The petitioner has made out a prima facie case for interim bail.

11. In the event of his arrest, the petitioner shall be enlarged on bail of Rs. 50,000/-(Rs. Fifty thousand) with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority under the conditions that;
(i) the petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer within 1 (one) week and co-operate with the investigation; and (ii) the petitioner shall not exercise threats to the victim or go anywhere near the vicinity of the victim.
On breach of any of the bail conditions, bail order shall stand cancelled.

12. Call for the Case Diary.
13.
